items.title: Button
items.description: The shared button for moi and its views.
items.docs:
# Button

Variants: `default`, `secondary`, `outline`, `ghost`, and `destructive`. Sizes: `xs`, `sm`, `default`, `lg`, `icon-xs`, `icon-sm`, `icon`, and `icon-lg`. Add `data-icon="inline-start"` or `data-icon="inline-end"` to inline icons. Use `buttonVariants` on links.

```tsx
<Button variant="outline">Open</Button>
```

items.name: drawer
items.title: Drawer
items.description: A Drawer scoped to moi views.
items.docs:
# Drawer

A Drawer that stays inside the moi view that opens it. It opens from the right and traps focus by default while leaving the rest of the view interactive. Pass modal={true} for a backdrop and full modal behavior. Every DrawerContent needs a DrawerTitle; use className="sr-only" when the title should be visually hidden. Put growing content in DrawerBody. DrawerContent includes a close button; pass showCloseButton={false} to hide it. Set swipeDirection on Drawer to choose another edge. Other Base UI Drawer props, including snap points, pass through. Compose custom triggers and close buttons with Base UI's render prop.

```tsx
<Drawer>
  <DrawerTrigger render={<Button variant="outline" />}>Details</DrawerTrigger>
  <DrawerContent>
    <DrawerHeader>
      <DrawerTitle>Order details</DrawerTitle>
      <DrawerDescription>Placed two days ago</DrawerDescription>
    </DrawerHeader>
    <DrawerBody>...</DrawerBody>
    <DrawerFooter>
      <DrawerClose render={<Button />}>Done</DrawerClose>
    </DrawerFooter>
  </DrawerContent>
</Drawer>
```
